fullDescription: Gising! is a high-energy, dark-mode design system specifically optimized for emergency monitoring, safety alerts, or critical utility applications. It features a bold 'Seismic' aesthetic using a palette of deep blacks, vivid reds (#ff2d55), and energetic oranges (#ff6a00). The style combines editorial typography (Clash Grotesk and Satoshi) with functional card-based layouts and immersive visual effects like moving scanlines, radial glows, and background grids. It is ideal for fintech, security, health alerts, or any interface requiring high visibility and urgent communication.

structured.summary: A bold, high-contrast dark-themed design system featuring vibrant red/orange accents, card-based mobile interfaces, and energetic micro-interactions designed for urgency and clarity.

style.description: The style is 'Cyber-Urgency,' characterized by a black background (#0a0608) with a 28px seismic grid and vibrant gradients. It uses Clash Grotesk for high-impact headings and Satoshi for readable body text. Key elements include glassmorphism-lite cards (#130b0e), glowing status indicators, and a consistent red-orange gradient (#ff2d55 to #ff6a00) for primary actions and toggles.
style.prompt:
Create a design with a 'Cyber-Urgency' aesthetic. 
- **Colors**: Background: #0a0608; Card BG: #130b0e; Primary Red: #ff2d55; Primary Orange: #ff6a00; Borders: #2e1520; Muted Text: #6b3345; Sub-text: #ff9ab0.
- **Typography**: Headings use 'Clash Grotesk' (Bold, -0.8px to -2px letter-spacing). Body text uses 'Satoshi' (Regular/Medium). Use uppercase labels with 0.12em tracking for section headers.
- **Background Effects**: A 28px x 28px grid of #ff2d55 at 4% opacity. Add multiple radial gradients: a large glow at the top (300px, 22% opacity #ff2d55) and smaller ambient glows on the edges. 
- **Global UI**: 1px borders with 18px-22px border-radius for cards. Use a moving horizontal scanline (2px height, 8% opacity red) that loops vertically every 6 seconds.

layout_and_structure.description: A mobile-first, vertical-scroll layout focused on grouping information into distinct, high-contrast cards. Sections are preceded by tight, uppercase labels and navigation is anchored by a persistent bottom tab bar.

prompts.prompt: The header should be fixed or top-aligned with significant padding (top: 56px, sides: 20px). It includes a large title in Clash Grotesk (26px) and a smaller subtitle. To the right, include a 'LIVE' status pill: background rgba(255,45,85,0.1), 1px solid border, and a blinking 6px red dot.

A card with padding: 16px. Left-side contains a 52px circular avatar with a dual-gradient ring border. Center contains a name (Clash Grotesk, 17px) and contact info. Right-side contains a 36px square edit button with a tinted background (12% red opacity).

Group items into cards. Each row should have: padding 14px 16px, an icon with a tinted background box (36x36px, 10px radius), a title (14px semi-bold), and a trailing element (Toggle Switch or Chevron). Separate rows with a 1px border (#2e1520) that is inset to align with the text rather than the icon.
Personal info fields should have uppercase 11px labels. Input fields: background #1a0d11, border #2e1520, radius 12px, padding 11px 14px. On focus, change border to #ff2d55 with a 3px outer glow.

A fixed bottom bar (#0e080b) with a 1px top border. Contains 4 icon-label pairs. Active state uses the brand red/orange; inactive state uses muted red #6b3345. Icons are 22px, labels are 10px uppercase.

special_ui_components.prompt: Track: 44x26px, 999px radius. 'Off' state: #2e1520 background with 1.5px border #3d1e28. 'On' state: linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00) with a red glow box-shadow. Thumb: 20x20px white circle, moves 18px horizontally with a cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) transition.

special_ui_components.description: A high-fidelity gradient border for profile images.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use a 2px border width. The border itself must be a linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00). The background should be a inner-glow tint of the same colors at 20-30% opacity.

Background: linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55, #ff6a00). Shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(255,45,85,0.45). Font: Clash Grotesk, 14px, 700 weight. Include a slight inset white glow (0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12)) at the top edge for a 'lit' effect. Scale to 0.97 on click/active.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain the 28px grid visibility. MUST use the staggered fade-up animation (translateY: 16px to 0px, opacity: 0 to 1) for all cards on load. MUST NOT use pure white backgrounds for any element. ALWAYS use #ff2d55 for critical/danger actions and the red/orange gradient for active states.
